# OIG: MA organizations overturned nearly all appealed SNF prior-auth denials

- Citation: HHS Office of Inspector General, OEI-09-24-00331, issued 2026-06-08. https://oig.hhs.gov/reports/all/2026/medicare-advantage-organizations-overturned-nearly-all-appealed-prior-authorization-denials-for-skilled-nursing-facility-admission-raising-concerns-about-initial-denials/
- Year: 2026 (data from June 2024)
- Tier: 1 (government)
- Sample / method: prior-auth requests for SNF admission at 19 Medicare Advantage organizations, June 2024; denial and appeal outcomes compared across MAOs and contractors.
- Key findings:
  - 12% of SNF admission requests were denied; the rate varied by MAO from 0.4% to 23%.
  - 18% of denials were appealed; on appeal, MAOs overturned 95% in favor of the enrollee.
  - Nursing home residents seeking a short-term SNF stay were denied at 40%, against 11% for other enrollees.
  - Denials made by the naviHealth contractor: 14% denial rate; 97% overturned on appeal.
  - Three recommendations to CMS (fix initial review breakdowns, assess variation, examine the nursing-home-resident gap). All are open.
- Limits: one month of data; 19 MAOs; doesn't measure the delay or cost a denial causes before it is overturned. Figures come from the summary page, not the full PDF.
